description: One row per country and year, one column per World Bank indicator. Best for single-country trends and side-by-side comparisons.
Long format: one row per country, indicator and year with indicator names. Best for ranking countries on an indicator.
Definitions and sources of each indicator.

content: Data is World Bank World Development Indicators for 20 countries, 2000 onward, as published (CC BY 4.0).
Units are in the column comments: _pct columns are percentages (0-100), gdp_per_capita_usd is current US dollars, co2_per_capita_t is tonnes CO2e per person, population is people.
poverty_3usd_day_pct is the share of people living on less than $3.00 a day (2021 PPP); it has gaps, so use the latest year that has a value and say which year it is.
For 'latest' questions use the most recent year with a non-null value for that indicator, per country, and always show the year.
Do not invent values for missing years; say the data is not available.
For change since a year, compare each country's earliest available value from that year onward (within 5 years) with its latest available value, show both years, and never compare a year with itself.

question: Which three countries reduced extreme poverty the most since 2000?
sql: WITH p AS (SELECT country_name, year, poverty_3usd_day_pct AS v FROM wb_demo.gold.country_indicator_wide WHERE poverty_3usd_day_pct IS NOT NULL AND year >= 2000), f AS (SELECT country_name, min(year) AS first_year, min_by(v, year) AS first_value, max(year) AS latest_year, max_by(v, year) AS latest_value FROM p GROUP BY country_name) SELECT country_name, first_year, round(first_value, 1) AS first_value, latest_year, round(latest_value, 1) AS latest_value, round(first_value - latest_value, 1) AS reduction_pct_points FROM f WHERE first_year <= 2005 AND latest_year > first_year ORDER BY reduction_pct_points DESC LIMIT 3

question: What was Kenya's access to electricity in 2010 and in the latest year?
sql: SELECT year, electricity_access_pct FROM wb_demo.gold.country_indicator_wide WHERE country_iso3 = 'KEN' AND electricity_access_pct IS NOT NULL AND (year = 2010 OR year = (SELECT max(year) FROM wb_demo.gold.country_indicator_wide WHERE country_iso3 = 'KEN' AND electricity_access_pct IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY year
